sources.entry: Claude Code Agent Monitor by hoangsonww - A self-hosted real-time dashboard that monitors Claude Code agent activity via its native hooks — live sessions, subagent orchestration trees, tool-call timelines, and per-session status — keeping data local (loopback-only). Built on Node/Express + React + SQLite, with a companion MCP server, VS Code extension, and desktop app.

summary.one_liner: A local-first, self-hosted dashboard that monitors Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex agent sessions in real time, including subagent orchestration, tool calls, token cost, and configuration.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a dashboard that shows live sessions from Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex in one place, with Dashboard, Sessions, Activity Feed, and Kanban views. It combines native hooks with provider-aware transcript discovery to record conversations, rendered Markdown, tool calls, command output, and attachments. It maps agent orchestration as parent-child trees, background agents, workflow runs, and tool-flow graphs, and reports model-aware token usage and cost with configurable pricing. It can launch Claude Code or Codex, stream output, send follow-ups, and resume work, and it shows Claude Code and Codex settings, skills, hooks, MCP servers, rules, and memory. A `ccam` CLI and a local MCP server expose the same data for humans and automation. The dashboard binds to 127.0.0.1 by default and supports optional tokens for wider exposure.
use_cases: monitor live Claude Code agent sessions
track token usage and cost of coding agents
review tool-call timelines and command output
query agent sessions from scripts via CLI or MCP
view and manage Claude Code or Codex configuration
stack: Electron-style desktop app (per README desktop guide)
notable: Provider-aware view of Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex sessions in one dashboard
Subagent orchestration trees, workflow runs, and tool-flow graphs
Loopback-only binding by default with optional auth tokens
Companion ccam CLI, local MCP server, VS Code extension, and desktop app
Plugin, skill, and subagent bundles installable via Claude Code and Codex marketplaces
caveats: Requires Node.js 22.22 or newer and npm 9 or newer
Remote access beyond loopback needs deliberate token setup per the security guidance
Full product reference is spread across many separate docs and a wiki rather than the README alone
keywords: see what my coding agent is doing
